উৎসঃ নবম - দশম শ্রেণি : বাংলা ২য় পত্র (নতুন সংস্করণ, ২০২১)

Bank Full Model Test.question:

19) The formula for cracking competitive exams is not applying shortcuts but going by full-fledged strategy.
Bank Full Model Test.option1: but going by the full-fledged strategy
Bank Full Model Test.option2: but going by the only full-fledged strategy

Bank Full Model Test.option4: but going by only full-fledged strategy

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩০) A paragraph is a series of sentences that are organized and coherent, and are all related to a _____.

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩১) While working 7 hour a day, A alone can complete a piece of work in 6 days and B alone in 8 days. In what time would they complete it together, 8 hour a day?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
A can complete the work in 7 × 6 = 42 hours
1 hour's work of A = 1/42

B can complete the work in 7 × 8 = 56 hours
1 hour's work of B = 1/56

(A + B)'s 1 hour's work
= 1/42 + 1/56
= (4 + 3)/168
= 7/168

৩৩) When the speed is increased to 4 kmph it takes 4 hours less to cover a distance of 32 km. Find the previous speed.

Previous speed = x

Or, (x + 4)x = 32
Or, x2 + 4x - 32 = 0
